def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max((v for row in g for v in row if v != 2), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2, bg, 8)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if col is not None:
        minc, maxc = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        mark = minc - 1 if maxc < col else maxc + 1
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][mark] = 8
        return g
    row = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in g[r])), None)
    if row is not None:
        minr, maxr = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        mark = minr - 1 if maxr < row else maxr + 1
        for c in range(w):
            g[mark][c] = 8
    return g

source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    background = max((v for row in g for v in row if v not in (2, 8)), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (background, 8)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    top = min(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    shift = divider + 1 - top
    for r, c, _ in cells:
        g[r][c] = background
    for r, c, value in cells:
        g[r + shift][c] = value
    marker = bottom + shift + 1
    if marker < h:
        g[marker] = [8] * w
    return g
'''
